title: CJ Olive Young says outside party accessed internal business system; personal data of 790 people leaked, Shinailbo reports
date_note: Shinailbo says the company confirmed the breach on 23 November and posted a notice on its website on 26 November; the notice day is used as the disclosure day.
geo_basis: The article names no city; the pin is a general location in South Korea.
summary: CJ Olive Young said on its website on 26 November that an outside party gained unauthorized access to its internal business system and some personal data leaked, according to Shinailbo. The company said it confirmed this on 23 November, and that the affected people number 790 in total: 639 employees, 106 partner-company staff and 45 general customers. The company said payment information and passwords were not leaked.
plain: Olive Young says an outside party got into an internal business system and personal data of 790 people leaked. The company says payment information and passwords were not leaked.
exec: Olive Young says personal data of 790 people leaked, including 45 general customers; it says payment information and passwords were not leaked.
action: No action needed; for awareness. The article gives no advice to affected people.

evidence.quote: 유출 대상은 총 790명으로 임직원 639명, 협력사 관계자 106명, 일반 고객 45명이다.
회사는 지난 23일 업무시스템에서 외부의 비인가 접근이 발생해 개인정보 일부가 유출된 사실을 확인했다고 26일 홈페이지에 공지했다.

validation.note: Only Korea Shinailbo was read, relaying the company's website notice; the notice itself was not found.
